source-integrity.provenance: SEC filing plus issuer manufacturing/launch evidence, independent FT and market-data origins
source-integrity.freshness: SEC 2026-09-03; Berlin issuer 2026-09-21; FT 2026-09-22; market 2026-09-21; Isar launch agreement 2026-07-06
source-integrity.duplicateOriginCollapse: issuer syndication collapsed; issuer sources are not counted as independent corroboration
source-integrity.sourceIndependence: SEC/issuer, FT and market-data origins separated
source-integrity.rawDerivedConsistency: Berlin manufacturing evidence now has an identified contracted deployment path, without treating planned launch or capacity as realized utilization/economics

company-underwriting.financialOperatingTrajectory: Q2 FY2027 revenue $116.1M, +58% YoY; backlog about $814.9M; 98% recurring ACV; adjusted EBITDA positive, while GAAP loss and capital intensity remain material.
company-underwriting.balanceSheet: Liquidity is offset by ATM/share-count dilution risk and continued constellation investment.
company-underwriting.customersContracts: Sovereign/defense demand supports visibility but increases procurement and concentration exposure.
company-underwriting.governanceCapitalAllocation: Growth/capacity execution is evident; long-duration capital allocation remains mixed because GAAP losses and dilution persist.
company-underwriting.pricingPowerConcentration: Recurring ACV/backlog support moderate value capture; hardware mix, concentration and substitutes constrain stronger pricing-power evidence.
company-underwriting.catalysts: Berlin manufacturing now has a contracted Isar Aerospace Pelican launch path targeted within 12 months of signing; realized production, launch and economics remain non-gating unknowns.

thesisQuality.basis: 58% YoY revenue growth, high recurring ACV and backlog demonstrate adoption, offset by GAAP losses and hardware mix.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Strong revenue/backlog growth and adjusted profitability coexist with GAAP loss, capex and dilution risk.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: Market valuation remains demanding relative to trailing revenue despite growth.

catalystScore.basis: Berlin manufacturing has an identified Pelican deployment agreement with Isar Aerospace and a stated launch target, while execution remains unproven.

governancePower.basis: Growth/capacity execution is credible but losses, ATM issuance and capital intensity keep stewardship evidence mixed.

alignment2036.basis: Persistent Earth observation and sovereign geospatial intelligence serve durable infrastructure/security needs.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Satellite/data capability spans government, defense and commercial uses; Berlin manufacturing is now linked to an identified European launch path.

bottleneckControl.basis: Owned constellation, ground infrastructure and manufacturing capacity create meaningful capability control, though substitutes exist.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Commercial and sovereign paths diversify demand, offset by capital intensity and defense concentration.

substitutionResilience.basis: Proprietary high-cadence imagery and infrastructure create moderate barriers, but commercial/government alternatives remain.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Berlin adds geographic manufacturing capacity and a named European launch partner, but realized redundancy and launch reliability remain unproven.

pricingPower.basis: Recurring ACV/backlog support moderate value capture; concentration, hardware mix and substitutes limit scarcity rent.

riskEvidence.basis: Losses, capex, dilution, concentration, substitution, valuation and launch/manufacturing execution risks are partly offset by liquidity/backlog.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Current SEC evidence plus independent capacity/demand, valuation and issuer launch-path evidence; realized Berlin utilization and mission economics remain undisclosed.

scoreRecord.thesis: Scaled Earth-observation infrastructure plus sovereign demand and added manufacturing/deployment capacity support durable relevance, while valuation, capital intensity and concentration constrain asymmetry.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: Backlog/capacity must convert into durable GAAP economics without excessive dilution while manufacturing/launch execution and competing imagery remain risks.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Berlin-built Pelican production and Isar launch execution, plus European sovereign award conversion into revenue/cash economics.

unknowns.item: Berlin realized utilization/unit economics and Isar mission economics are undisclosed.
Long-run customer concentration/renewal economics remain uncertain.
